text.text: For they counted all the idols of the heathen to be gods: which neither have the use of eyes to see, nor noses to draw breath, nor ears to hear, nor fingers of hands to handle; and as for their feet, they are slow to go.
Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.
For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
